assumptions.Details: All projections are estimates based on publicly available government policies, investment summits data, news reports, and industry analyst reports. Actual outcomes may vary significantly.
2026-2035 (10-year horizon); some projects with 2024-2025 start dates are included where already underway.

UP Invest Summit 2023, UP Industrial Investment Policy 2022, NASSCOM India IT/GCC 2024, SIAM Auto Data 2024, MeitY Semiconductor Mission, MNRE Solar Data, AAI Annual Report 2023-24, PM Gati Shakti Portal, MoHUA Smart City Mission, JLL India Warehousing 2024, CREDAI NCR, TRAI 5G Report, DPIIT FDI/Startup India Reports, RBI Annual Report, NHM UP.
INR Crore (1 Crore = 10 million INR). Values include announced + committed + pipeline investment. Where ranges exist, mid-point used.
Include direct employment only unless stated otherwise. Indirect/induced employment multiplier (typically 3-5x for manufacturing) NOT included.
High = government-confirmed projects with MoU/LOI; Medium = announced but pre-approval; Low = projected based on policy trajectory
Low = <20% tasks automatable by 2035; Medium = 20-50%; High = >50% tasks at automation risk (WEF Future of Jobs 2023 methodology)
Based on McKinsey Global Institute occupation automation potential scores adapted for India context (2024)
LPA = Lakhs Per Annum (Indian Rupees). Ranges represent entry to senior within job category. Metro premium ~20-30% vs non-metro.

1) Bar chart: Top 20 sectors by employment generation; 2) Pie: UP vs NCR investment share; 3) Heat map: District-wise job density; 4) Line: Year-on-year hiring projections 2026-2035; 5) Bubble: Investment vs Jobs vs Automation Risk
